Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/942)
I believe I wrote before and asked whether you thought it worth while to revive two or three books of mine that have gone out of print. I have been asked about them again, which leads me to write. ‘[The Two Guardians](/book/13)’ and ‘[Henrietta’s Wish’](/book/11) were published by [Masters](/organisation/112) and went through three editions at least, then I heard no more of them and his business has been given up.

The copyright is mine.

They are both ‘stories for young people’ and were a good deal liked and honestly I think there is good work in them.
[Kenneth or the Rear Guard of the Grand Army](/book/10) was published by [Parker of Oxford](/person/1142). I believe he has let it drop, but there must be some merit in it since Mr E Arnold wrote to ask permission to make extracts in a Reading book
I thank you much for the beautiful series on Natural History.

The birds delight me much
Yours very truly

C M Yonge
